description.value: Loop Brook Campground offers frontcountry trailer and tent sites in Glacier National Park, right at Rogers Pass and accessible from the Trans-Canada Highway; a national park pass plus camping permit are required, and strict bear-safe food storage is mandatory.

address.value: Trans-Canada Highway, Columbia-Shuswap, BC V0E 2S0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The primary evidence source is the Parks Canada Glacier National Park camping page, which explicitly names Loop Brook Campground as offering 'reservable trailer and tent sites' and confirms it accepts reservations ('Reservations are accepted at Illecillewaet Campground, Loop Brook Campground'). The page also confirms bear-proof food lockers are available at campgrounds ('kept in bear-proof food lockers'). No other specific amenity details (showers, water, laundry, etc.) are mentioned for this campground on this general park camping page.
concerns: The OSM website URL points to a general Glacier/Mount Revelstoke park camping overview page rather than a campground-specific page; detailed amenity information (water, showers, electrical hookups, etc.) is not available from this source.
No address or phone number in OSM record; address could not be confirmed from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Loop Brook Campground is a legitimate, actively operated Parks Canada campground in Glacier National Park along the Trans-Canada Highway — a major cycling route through Rogers Pass — making it directly relevant to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM capacity listed as 20 sites. The general Parks Canada phone for reservations is 1-877-737-3783 (from the contact subpage), but this is not specific to Loop Brook Campground and was not in the OSM record.

wow_evidence: Parks Canada campground in Glacier National Park, right at Rogers Pass and accessible from the Trans-Canada Highway
